cycleSettingsIntro: All optional. Only turn on what fits you — you can change it any time.
cycleOnboardingText: Would you like to track your cycle, menopause or a pregnancy? Choose what fits — or skip this step.

cycleModePregnancySubtitle: Weeks, prenatal check-up plan, weight and blood pressure; pauses period estimates
cycleCreateGynecologist: Add a gynecologist to your doctors
cycleCreateGynecologistSubtitle: Placeholder you can edit later — e.g. for appointments and the doctor PDF
cyclePrivacyNote: Cycle and pregnancy data are especially sensitive. They stay encrypted on this device. Tip: turn on the app lock under Settings → Security.
cycleShowFertileSubtitle: Only a rough estimate — not a method of contraception
cycleDeleteAllText: All cycle, menopause and pregnancy entries will be permanently deleted and the sections turned off. Your doctors are kept.

cycleDayDeleteText: All details for this day will be deleted.
cyclePbacSubtitle: For a clearer picture if periods are heavy
cyclePbacExplain: PBAC (Higham 1990): count pads/tampons by how soaked they are, clots and flooding. More than 100 points per cycle suggest heavy menstrual bleeding — worth having checked.
cyclePbacClotsLarge: Clot, large (about a 50p/2-euro coin or larger)
cycleStatusNoData: No period logged yet — log the first day.
cycleStatusNextIn: {days, plural, =1{next period in ~1 day (estimated)} other{next period in ~{days} days (estimated)}}
cycleEstimateDisclaimer: Estimate based on your past cycles — not a method of contraception or a pregnancy test.
cycleQuickLogSymptoms: {count, plural, =1{1 symptom logged} other{{count} symptoms logged}}
cycleCalendarHint: Tap a day to log or change it.
cycleInsightsNotEnough: Averages and estimates need at least two logged periods.
cycleInsightsPeriod: {count, plural, =1{Period avg. {average} days · 1 cycle analysed} other{Period avg. {average} days · {count} cycles analysed}}
cycleInsightsEmpty: Nothing to show yet — log a few days and charts will appear here.
cycleChartLengthHelp: Bars = cycle length, darker part = period. Shaded: 21–35 days; dashed: your average.
cycleChartLengthSemantics: Lengths of the last {count} cycles: {values} days
cycleChartPainHelp: Each row is a cycle, each column a cycle day. This shows patterns such as pain just before or at the start of a period.
cycleChartPainSemantics: Pain across {count} cycles; strong pain on cycle day {days}
cycleChartPhaseHelp: Share of logged days in each phase with the symptom. Phases are estimated from your cycles.
cycleChartHotFlashSemantics: Hot flushes per week, last 12 weeks: {values}
cycleChartBpHelp: In pregnancy, please discuss readings of 140/90 mmHg or higher with your doctor promptly.
cycleHintsFooter: This is not a diagnosis — just a pointer from your entries.
cycleHintShortCycles: Your cycles were repeatedly shorter than 21 days (median {days} days).
cycleHintLongCycles: Your cycles were repeatedly longer than 35 days (median {days} days).
cycleHintIrregular: Your cycle lengths vary by {days} days (shortest to longest).
cycleHintLongPeriod: A period lasted {days} days (longer than 7 days).
cycleHintHeavyBleeding: PBAC of {score} points in one cycle (over 100 suggests heavy bleeding).
cycleHintStrongPain: Strong pain (7/10 or more) on {days} days in one cycle.
cycleHintIntermenstrual: {days, plural, =1{Spotting on 1 day between periods (last 90 days).} other{Spotting on {days} days between periods (last 90 days).}}
cycleHintPostmenopausal: Bleeding after more than 12 months without a period — please get it checked.
cycleHintPregnancyBleeding: Please get bleeding in pregnancy checked soon — often harmless, but important to know.
cycleHintFetalMovement: If you feel your baby moving less than usual, please contact your practice or maternity unit soon.
cycleMrsIntro: Which of the following complaints do you currently have — and how strongly? Please answer each one. Once a month is enough.
cycleMrsExplain: A short, validated questionnaire (11 questions) — once a month it shows how your symptoms change.
cycleMrsSource: Menopause Rating Scale after Heinemann et al. (Health Qual Life Outcomes 2003; 2004). Total 0–44: 0–4 none/little, 5–8 mild, 9–16 moderate, 17+ severe.
cycleMrsItem2: Heart discomfort (unusual awareness of heartbeat, heart skipping, racing, tightness)
cycleMrsItem3: Sleep problems (difficulty falling asleep, sleeping through, waking up early)
cycleMrsItem4: Depressive mood (feeling down, sad, on the verge of tears, lack of drive, mood swings)
cycleMrsItem5: Irritability (feeling nervous, inner tension, feeling aggressive)
cycleMrsItem7: Physical and mental exhaustion (decrease in performance, impaired memory, poor concentration, forgetfulness)
cycleMrsItem8: Sexual problems (change in sexual desire, activity and satisfaction)
cycleMrsItem9: Bladder problems (difficulty urinating, increased need to urinate, bladder incontinence)
cycleMrsItem10: Dryness of vagina (sensation of dryness or burning, difficulty with sexual intercourse)
cycleMrsItem11: Joint and muscular discomfort (pain in the joints, rheumatoid complaints)
cycleMrsNotYet: Menopause: MRS questionnaire not filled in yet
cyclePregnancyNoDates: Pregnancy: enter your last period or the due date.
cyclePregnancyDaysToDue: {days, plural, =0{due today} =1{1 day to due date} other{{days} days to due date}}
cyclePregnancyDueNote: The due date is a guide — few babies arrive exactly on that day.
cyclePregnancyTimelineSource: Based on the German maternity guidelines: check-ups every 4 weeks, every 2 weeks from week 32; three routine ultrasounds. Your practice plans individually.
cyclePregnancyEndText: The pregnancy will be closed and the section hidden. Your entries are kept. You can optionally say how it ended.
cycleTopicDescription: Expected period, monthly questionnaire, check-up suggestions — discreet by default
cycleReminderBody: Log it in your cycle diary when it starts.
cycleReminderMrsTitle: Time for your monthly menopause questionnaire
cycleReminderMilestoneBody: Suggestion from your check-up plan — booked yet?

cycleReportFooter: Self-recorded in Mai Doctor Hub. Estimates and pointers are not a diagnosis.

cycleStartLastQuestion: When did your last period start?

cycleStartLengthQuestion: How long is your cycle usually?
cycleStartLengthHelp: From the first day of one period to the first day of the next.
cycleStartCardText: With two or three details, the estimate of your next period starts right away.
cycleEstimateFromAnswers: Estimated from your answers until enough of your own cycles are logged — not a method of contraception or a pregnancy test.
cycleEstimateDefaultLength: Estimated with an average 28-day cycle (default) until your own cycles are logged — not a method of contraception or a pregnancy test.
